coverage.assessment: The revision removed the last sentence explaining what the Trusts were, leaving 'Trusts' earliest victims' and sympathy 'as a measure of motion' unsupported. 'Better reason' in p4 has no first reason expressed beside it. The decline in Paris loses its cause in affairs.
'The umpire' appears without the source's setup sentence or the later umpire/spectators sentence. Locations and dates (New York, Washington, Nervi, Nauheim, Paris, Armenonville) are coherent.

V4 is exact. Adams remonstrates first, Hay replies, and 'Each was correct' stays. Splitting the exchange into three paragraphs slightly loosens the source's run-in compression but does not confuse speakers.
'He thought'/'he found' are dropped, turning Adams's judgment on Russia into narratorial fact. The 1938 'perhaps' and the theory's 'if' are preserved. No cause of death is added.
The retrospective distance is intact. Hay's death is not anticipated beyond the source's own foreshadowing, the delay measuring 'the time that Hay had to spare'.

Several of the voice's devices are trimmed: the mock-commercial 'pay millions at sight', the self-deprecating 'kinetic theory of gas', 'One has done it so often!', and the Armenonville vanity irony. The core periodic sentences and verbatim lines remain.

The crown-of-peacemaker versus cross-of-martyrdom sentence is lost. It is what makes Adams's final remonstrance complicit and ironic. The rationale for satisfaction at Hay's death (emperors fading into obscurity) is also cut.

The caravan and King dependencies are intact at both ends. In 009 the partner keeps the I Street house but drops the name 'Markoe'. The local line still stands on its own via 'I Street' and 'forty-four years earlier', so this is not charged to the revision.

dependencies.assessment: The caravan clause is retained locally, and 018 keeps the 1868 caravan image, so the arc closes.

evidence.quote: when they saw American society as a long caravan stretching out towards the plains
Society offered the profile of a long, straggling caravan, stretching loosely towards the prairies

dependencies.assessment: The local line is retained with 'forty-four years earlier' and stands on its own. The 009 partner keeps the I Street house but drops the name 'Markoe', so the name is first met here. This is an existing neighbor cut, not a defect of this revision.

evidence.quote: almost as gay as when he first lighted on the Markoe house in I Street forty-four years earlier
took a house on I Street, well out towards Georgetown, where the private secretary began to learn his social duties

dependencies.assessment: 'Three friends' is kept without renaming King's death, and 030 retains King's funeral. 'Summons' even echoes.

evidence.quote: The three friends had begun life together; and the last of the three had no motive
The first summons that met Adams, before he had even landed on the pier at New York, December 29, was to Clarence King's funeral.

findings.claim: The source explains that the Trusts embodied the new power since 1840 and tore society to pieces. The first draft kept only a short version, and the revision removed it entirely. 'Under the laws of mechanics' was already gone in the first draft.
findings.counterevidence: 'Battling Trusts' and the later description of the Trusts' organization in p3 give partial context.

evidence.quote: The Trusts and Corporations stood for the larger part of the new power that had been created since 1840
The Trusts stood for the larger part of the new power that had been created since 1840; they were revolutionary
As one of the Trusts' earliest victims, a citizen of Quincy, born in 1838, had learned submission and silence

findings.minimal_repair: Reinsert before 'As one of': 'The Trusts stood for the larger part of the new power that had been created since 1840, and tore society to pieces.'
findings.plan_relation: Required (essential: Trusts, sympathy as a measure of motion, early victim). The screws simile was optional; the definitional sentence was not.
findings.reader_effect: Readers cannot see why Adams counts himself an early victim or why the Battle of Trusts measures motion, which weakens the essential argument.
findings.title: Trusts left undefined; 'earliest victims' and 'measure of motion' lose their basis

findings.claim: The source introduces the umpire through both energies having been familiar since childhood without favoring him. It returns to the image with players and spectators. Both sentences are cut, as is the new man as 'child' of old and new energies.
findings.counterevidence: Context makes it inferable that Adams is the umpire.

evidence.quote: Both had been familiar since childhood, as the story has shown, and neither had warped the umpire's judgment by its favors.
The new man could be only a child born of contact between the new and the old energies.
If ever judge had reason to be impartial, it was the umpire.

findings.minimal_repair: Restore the two short source sentences: 'The new man could be only a child born of contact between the new and the old energies. Both had been familiar since childhood, and neither had warped the umpire's judgment by its favors.'
findings.plan_relation: Essential item ('Adams as impartial umpire'); a planning-level risk not flagged.
findings.reader_effect: The umpire metaphor and its claim of impartiality appear abruptly. They also sit uneasily beside 'victims' with no explanation.
findings.title: 'The umpire' arrives without setup or reason for impartiality

findings.claim: The revision cut two things from p1. One is the mock-commercial 'ready to pay millions at sight'. The other is the sentence on the old type's catastrophic failure, which motivated the demand for a new man and the Diocletian anarchy.
findings.counterevidence: 'Ten times the endurance... of the old type' keeps the comparison. The cut helps meet the word target.

evidence.quote: the new man seemed close at hand, for the old one had plainly reached the end of his strength, and his failure had become catastrophic.
for whom they were ready to pay millions at sight. The old one had plainly reached the end of his strength
will and mind of the old type. A traveller in the highways of history looked out of the club window

findings.minimal_repair: If space allows, restore 'The old one had plainly reached the end of his strength, and his failure had become catastrophic.'
findings.plan_relation: Optional tradeoff within the essential new-man item.
findings.reader_effect: The new-man demand is still stated, but the paragraph loses its contrast between new and old and some of its sardonic market voice.
findings.title: Revision trims the old man's catastrophic failure and the 'millions at sight' irony

findings.claim: The source has Adams urge that the peacemaker's crown was worth the cross of martyrdom, 'but the cross was full in sight.' The draft fuses that sentence into the Russian-inertia sentence and omits the urging.
findings.counterevidence: Adams's hope for Hay's peace-making survives, as required.

evidence.quote: could only urge that vanity for vanity, the crown of peacemaker was worth the cross of martyrdom; but the cross was full in sight
Adams, who had set his heart on seeing Hay close his career by making peace in the East, found his formula for Russian inertia exasperatingly correct.

findings.minimal_repair: After 'in the East,' restore 'could only urge that the crown of peacemaker was worth the cross of martyrdom; but the cross was full in sight. He'. Then continue with 'found his formula...'
findings.plan_relation: Essential ('Adams's hope that Hay would make peace'); the plan did not flag the crown/cross clause.
findings.reader_effect: The remonstrance 'You must hold out' loses its preparation as Adams's knowing complicity in pressing a dying friend.
findings.title: Adams's crown/cross urging cut, flattening the irony of the final remonstrance

findings.claim: Several connected cuts weaken the voyage and decline. 'One has done it so often!' is cut. So is 'threw off the coloring of office and mortality together', leaving a weaker 'but' seam. In Paris, the draft omits that affairs and interviews wore Hay out.
findings.counterevidence: The smile, the Markoe recall and the 'lambs in a butcher's shop' line survive. No cause of death is added.

evidence.quote: bids good-bye with a smile. One has done it so often! Hay could scarcely pace the deck
the return to affairs and interviews wore him rapidly out
Hay nourished no illusions, but the malaria of power left its only trace in the sense of tasks incomplete.
he showed, at the first glance, that he had lost strength, and in his last talk

findings.minimal_repair: Restore 'One has done it so often!' Add 'and the return to affairs wore him rapidly out' after 'lost strength'.
findings.reader_effect: The farewell loses its wry rhythm. Hay's renewed decline is stated without its link to the 'malaria of power'.
findings.title: Voyage and decline compressed: elegiac beat and cause of decline lost

findings.claim: Three things are cut from the close. One is the emperors-fading-into-obscurity reason for Adams's satisfaction. Another is the irony of Armenonville as worldly vanity's 'most futile climax'. The third is Shakespeare's 'commonplace' framing of 'The rest is silence.'
findings.counterevidence: V5, V6, 1938 'perhaps', 'three friends' and 'Hamlet's Shakespearean silence' all survive.

evidence.quote: One had seen scores of emperors and heroes fade into cheap obscurity even when alive; and now, at least, one had not that to fear for one's friend.
where worldly vanity reached its most futile climax in human history
in the full flare of Paris frivolity; it was only the quiet summons to follow--the assent to dismissal.

findings.minimal_repair: Optionally restore the emperors sentence after 'to the last.'
findings.reader_effect: The elegy is still intact, but 'satisfied' has less grounding, and the contrast between Paris frivolity and silence is muted.
findings.title: Ending loses the rationale for satisfaction and the Armenonville vanity irony

findings.claim: The source frames the Russia judgment as Adams's view: 'He thought that Russia should have negotiated' and 'he found that she had not the energy'. The draft drops both attributions.
findings.counterevidence: It follows 'found his formula... exasperatingly correct,' so a free-indirect reading is possible.

evidence.quote: He thought that Russia should have negotiated instantly on the fall of Port Arthur, January 1, 1905; he found that she had not the energy
Russia should have negotiated instantly on the fall of Port Arthur; she had not the energy

findings.minimal_repair: Prefix 'He thought that' and insert 'he found that' before 'she had'.
findings.plan_relation: Not addressed by plan; small fidelity repair.
findings.reader_effect: This loses the hedged, observer stance central to the voice, and a contestable judgment becomes flat assertion.
findings.title: Adams's opinion on Russia converted into narratorial fact

findings.claim: In the source, 'a better reason' answers the uselessness of a nineteenth-century education. It also comes with Adams's claim that he cared no more for his theory than for the kinetic theory of gas. Both are cut.
findings.counterevidence: P2's 'learned submission and silence' supplies an implicit first reason, and the 'if' hedge survives.

evidence.quote: but Adams had a better reason for holding his tongue. For his dynamic theory of history he cared no more than for the kinetic theory of gas
Adams had a better reason for holding his tongue. His dynamic theory of history, if it were an approach to measurement of motion

findings.minimal_repair: Insert 'For his dynamic theory he cared no more than for the kinetic theory of gas; but,' before 'if it were an approach'.
findings.plan_relation: Voice profile (self-deprecation, hedging); not flagged in plan.
findings.reader_effect: The comparative has no first reason beside it. The theory sounds more self-confidently held than the source allows.
findings.title: 'Better reason' lacks its comparison; self-deprecating hedge on the theory lost

strengths: All six verbatim units survive exactly, including the final exchange with correct turn order and 'Each was correct.'
The Scott quotation is kept short and without comment. The obscurity-versus-Hay's-exposure link survives the cut seal-baiting passage.
The Russian-inertia delay 'measured precisely the time that Hay had to spare' preserves the chapter's quiet foreshadowing.
The ending retains the summons/dismissal turn, 'three friends', and the speculative 1938 'perhaps', and stops at THE END.
summary: The revision is identical to the first draft except for two cuts in paragraphs 1–2. Both cuts thin the essential Trusts and new-man argument. All verbatim units, the final exchange, the Armenonville death, the 'perhaps' 1938 close and THE END survive intact. The chief problems are inherited compressions. The Trusts' role is no longer explained, so 'earliest victims' and 'measure of motion' are unsupported. 'The umpire' arrives without setup. Adams's urging of Hay ('crown'/'cross') is gone. Several elegiac and ironic turns in the voyage and ending are also cut. Nothing misleads badly enough to block publication.
